vetSays.line: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +4 clean.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek is humming something. It stops when they notice you listening.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek came back with 352 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek hesitates, then backs off. "Not today. Sorry." (Low trust — reluctant.)
👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek: "Quiet birds. I'll add it to the list of things that mean something."
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." The pantry won't fill itself.
You catch fragments by the fire — A person, maybe 40s telling A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek about you. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.
📋 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek — 🪾 Gather deadfall. They'll report back by next part.
🍂 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek gathers deadfall — 1 stick + 1 fiber. The pile grows. (1 sticks now.)
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +3 clean.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek and Sari are comparing scars like trading cards.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." Company makes the road shorter.
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek telling Ella about themself. It's picking up decorations as it travels.
You've started noticing: Nino and A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek never speak. It's not new. (Something old lives in Haven.)

Brian sets out to find A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek. "Won't be long." Company makes the road shorter.
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +2 clean.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." Company makes the road shorter.
You catch fragments by the fire — A person, maybe 20s telling A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek about you. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +4 clean.
🚶 Brian is back — found A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek.
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek telling Ella about Brian. The story's getting bigger than what happened.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
You catch fragments by the fire — Ella telling A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek about you. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +3 clean.
...and then it lands: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
🛡️ Ella, Ada, Carmen, Sari and Tashi met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Ella, Ada, Carmen, Sari, Tashi are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tashi just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ada just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ella, Ada, Sari and Fatima met them at the door — 4 put down. Ella, Ada, Sari, Fatima are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Brian just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ada just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ada just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ada, Carmen, Sari and Tashi met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Carmen, Sari are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Carlos just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Carlos met them at the door — 1 put down. Carlos is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Duc just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Lan and Duc met them at the door — 2 put down. Lan, Duc are hurt.
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
Blooded — the village knows where the Producers bleed. (Strikes hit 1.5× as hard; their blows land at 0.75× strength.)
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
